{{Quote|Halthor! Halthor! How many useless planets does Mand'alor need?|A Mandalorian|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic: War 4">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 4|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Halthor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] invaded by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] under the command of [[Dorjander Kace]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] at the [[Battle of Halthor]].

*[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 2|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 2]] {{1st}}
